Your turn

Useful phrases: Can I help you? · What would you like? · Here you are. · That is €3.50, please. · Here is your change: €6.50. · It is €8. · They are €14.
No € on your keyboard? Write: That is 3.50 euros, please.

Rules

  1. You work in a gift shop in Dublin (Ireland). Serve 5 customers every day. In Ireland people pay with euros (€).
  2. Greet the customer: Can I help you? or What would you like?
  3. Read (or listen to) what the customer wants. Tap the things into the basket – the right number and the right size!
  4. Write the price: That is €4.50, please. Then give the change: Here is your change: €5.50. You can also write 4.50 euros.
  5. Questions about prices: It is €8. for one thing, They are €14. for headphones, sunglasses, socks, jeans.
  6. Every mistake costs the customer’s patience ♥. No patience left = the customer leaves angry and your shop loses a star ★.
  7. Every day is harder. Five stars lost = the shop closes!

Day 1 is over!
